The current scheme requires an asbestos-inventory company to have at least one DIA working under an employment contract; inventory work is performed by a DIA.
The technical final responsible person must be a DIA, meet an experience or annual-work condition, know the quality system and sign the inventory report.
The certificate-holder must immediately report changes of directors, management, owners and UBOs; a process certificate lasts at most three years and each branch is reviewed at least annually.

The current scheme requires a tailored documented quality system including organisation, roles, document controls, internal reviews, procurement controls, safety instructions and corrective-action procedures, and requires inventory reports and related data to be kept at least ten years.
The scheme separates asbestos inventory from removal ownership and generally bars one UBO or director from two inventory firms unless concern-level DIA and report thresholds are met.
The scheme's project-site assessment table requires four annual assessments for 1–2 DIAs and under 500 reports, and six for 3–5 DIAs or 500–1,100 reports.
